commentary.bulkers: Polska Zegluga Morska have committed their Kamsarmax "Ornak" 79/2010 New Century, China (SS 09/2030, DD 09/2028) at USD 11,35 mill. Remind you that back in September, the one-year-younger sister vessel "Rysy" 79/2011 New Century, China (SS/DD 03/2026) was sold at high USD 11 mill. The Panamax "Yasa Team" 75/2006 Sanoyas, Japan (SS/DD 02/2026) of Ya Sa Shipping was committed to Chinese interests at USD 9,3 mill. For comparison, the "Andria" 75/2006 Universal, Japan (SS 02/2029, DD 02/2027) was sold in October at high USD 9 mill. On the Supramax sector, following the sale of the "Forever SW" 58/2010 Tsuneishi Cebu, Philippines (SS 05/2030, DD 04/2028) a month ago at USD 15,2 mill, Shih Wei Navigation have now committed the one-year-younger sister vessel "Eternity SW" 58/2011 Tsuneishi Cebu, Philippines (SS/DD 02/2026) at USD 15,7 mill. Furthermore, the "Karadeniz S" 57/2012 Stx, Korea (SS/DD 07/2027) was committed at USD 14,25 mill, while the sister vessel "Marmara S" 57/2012 Stx, Korea (SS 08/2027, DD 11/2025) was sold a couple of months ago at USD 13,85 mill. In addition, Sunrise Bulk Carrier committed the "Mandarin Eagle" 56/2008 Jiangsu, China (SS 06/2028, DD 03/2026) at USD 10,5 mill. Note that a couple of weeks ago, the one-year- younger sister vessel "Sea Dana" 57/2009 Jiangsu, China (SS 05/2029, DD 10/2026) was sold at USD 11 mill. Wilmar International committed the Handysize "Arawana" 32/2012 Taizhou, China (SS/DD 05/2027) at USD 9,5 mill. Remind you that the one- year-older sister vessel "T Symphony" 32/2011 Taizhou, China (SS/DD 08/2026) was sold in September at USD 8,6 mill.
commentary.tankers: Eurotankers have committed their Suezmax "Euroleader" 159/2005 Hyundai, Korea (SS 02/2030, DD 06/2028) to undisclosed interests at USD 29,3 mill. For comparion, the "Konya" 163/2005 Hyundai, Korea 9SS 05/2030, DD 07/2028) was sold a month ago at USD 28,4 mill. The LR1 "Amalia" 73/2006 New Century, China (SS/DD 12/2026) of TB Marine was committed to Chinese interests at USD 11,5 mill, while the one- year-younger "Chemtrans Cancale" 73/2007 New Century, China (SS 06/2027, DD 03/2026) was sold a couple of weeks ago at USD 12 mill. US Marine Management committed the MR2 "Yosemite Trader" 48/2011 Iwagi, Japan (SS/DD 03/2026) to Vietnamese interests at USD 21,5 mill. For reference, the one-year-older sister vessel "T Matterhorn" 48/2010 Iwagi, Japan (SS/DD 12/2025) was sold a month ago at USD 20 mill basis T/C attached till Q1 2026.
